evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Distinct method and goal from profile, metadata, video-similarity, and ASR search stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Profile-based music discovery is not duplicated by fingerprint, similar-user, or content-based stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Similar-user music search differs from own-profile search and from broad content recommendation stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Content-similarity from a given music video is distinct from fingerprint identification and image-based video recommendation.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Metadata and image-tag music discovery is a distinct search context from fingerprint or content-similarity search.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Upload and tag availability is a distinct preprocessing requirement not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Thumbnail sequence viewing is unique among video navigation and info stories.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Generic similar-video information is not the same requirement as the perceptual-similarity variant.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Perceptually similar video information is a meaningful specific context distinct from generic similarity.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Passive content recommendation from similar profiles is distinct from active music search based on similar users.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: News-event and area-based recommendation is a unique context not found in other recommendation stories.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Person identification is a distinct object from product, logo, or brand identification stories.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Product identification is a distinct object from person, logo, or brand identification stories.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Broadcaster-logo identification is a specific object, distinct from person, product, and general brand stories.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: General brand identification is distinct from specific broadcaster-logo identification and other object stories.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Image-query video recommendation is distinct from music-video similarity and map/ASR content access.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Map-based video discovery is a unique location context.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR content search is distinct from fingerprint, profile, and metadata music search.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Admin segmentation validation/editing is distinct from annotation and topic extraction.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: News segment annotation/topic extraction is a distinct goal from segmentation validation.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: A/V quality ranking is a distinct admin task not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Pre-upload audio edit detection is distinct from copyright validation and content prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Nudity prefiltering is a specific content rule distinct from low/high-level asset search and copyright checks.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low-level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Low-level asset search prefiltering is meaningfully distinct from high-level metadata/tag search prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Copyright-infringement validation is a distinct business rule from audio-edit detection and content prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high-level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: High-level metadata/tag search prefiltering is meaningfully distinct from low-level asset search prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Picture interest/appeal/complexity assessment is a unique analytic goal.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Scientist prompting trigger is distinct from interest assessment and volunteer comment detection.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer typing is distinct from classification weighting and project recommendation stories.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low-level image features
evaluations.rationale: Galaxy Zoo image preclassification is domain-specific and distinct from Snapshot Serengeti or Plankton Portal tasks.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Empty Snapshot Serengeti image detection is distinct in project domain from empty Plankton Portal image detection.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti images
evaluations.rationale: Timestamping malfunction series detection is distinct from other Snapshot Serengeti analysis tasks.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti is domain- and task-specific.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification differs from species and number detection in the same project.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Animal count detection is distinct from species and attribute preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Plankton localization is distinct from empty-image detection and size/orientation/species tasks.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Empty Plankton Portal image detection is domain-specific and distinct from Snapshot Serengeti empty-image detection.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Plankton size/orientation detection is distinct from localization and species classification.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Plankton species preclassification is distinct in project domain from Snapshot Serengeti species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Worm motion analysis for video reduction is distinct from egg-laying detection.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Egg-laying time detection is a distinct event-detection requirement from motion analysis.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Satellite image feature detection is domain-specific and not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer's classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Classification weighting is distinct from volunteer typing and project recommendation.

evaluations.evidence: perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Image artifact removal is distinct from other image analysis and audio noise removal stories.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Moving/transient object detection is distinct from artifact removal and static image preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Audio noise removal is a distinct domain from image artifact removal and whale-call grouping.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Whale-call grouping is domain-specific and distinct from generic subject grouping by similarity.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Whale count identification is distinct from whale-call grouping.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Interruption timing is distinct from whether to interrupt and from education timing/medium stories.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Interruption medium is distinct from interruption timing and education medium.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Education timing is a different action and goal from interruption timing.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Education medium is distinct from education timing and interruption medium.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Specific education content selection is distinct from education timing and medium.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Detecting interesting volunteer comments is distinct from Zoonibot commenting and scientist prompting.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Zoonibot comment timing is distinct from explanation timing and from what Zoonibot should say.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Explanation timing is a distinct bot action from general commenting and content selection.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Message content selection is distinct from timing-related Zoonibot stories.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Generic subject grouping is distinct from domain-specific whale-call grouping by similarity.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Project recommendation is a distinct goal from content recommendation and volunteer typing.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Article summarization for reuse is not repeated elsewhere in the backlog.
